desc: There are two ways to build a 1911. You can run them down a line, swap parts until they fit well enough, box them up and ship them out. Or you can build them by hand, one at a time, the way they were meant to be built. The Grizz is the second kind. Every Grizz that leaves this shop was built by the same set of hands from frame to muzzle. We have two builders here. That’s it. One of them built your gun, fit the barrel, tuned the trigger, dialed the extractor, dressed every surface. Not a team. Not a line. One person who takes it personally when something isn’t right. Before your gun ships, that same builder loads up your two included magazines and runs the gun. Not a function check. Actually shoots it. If something needs attention, it gets attention, right then, by the person who built it. What shows up at your door is a tuned, proven rig, not a box of parts that happened to pass inspection.
